Tells which Flip ended the last measured frame, counted from the start of the program. It is the number that the lines of [ProfileSlow](ProfileSlow) show, and it changes with every [Flip](Flip), which is how a program notices that new numbers are there for [ProfileFrameValue](ProfileFrameValue).

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
Flip
Print ProfileFrameNumber()
```
@returns The number of the Flip, or 0 before the first measured frame and without `--profile`.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
